title: Points expired
description: Points expired: the expiry job wrote off the member's due lots and took them in expiry order. One event reports the whole transaction, `points` is the total expired and `lots` is the lots it took; `available` and `debt` are the member's balances after the change. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the member.

points.description: The total points this expiry transaction wrote off.

lots.description: The lots this expiry transaction took, in expiry order.

lotId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the lot.

points.description: The points this lot still held when it expired.

expiresAt.description: When the lot expired, in UTC.

available.description: The member's available balance after the change, computed from lots minus debt.

debt.description: The member's debt after the change.
